name: lightcone-feedback
description: Report a bug, request a feature or send other feedback on the Lightcone Research stack from an agent session. The agent drafts a sanitized GitHub issue from the session's evidence, routes it to the right Lightcone repository, checks for duplicates, and files it only after you approve the exact text. Filing uses the GitHub CLI (`gh`); the agent walks you through setting it up if it's missing.
